title.narrative: Improving Capacities of the Ministry of the Interior in the SALW-Control related Field, Phase III

description.narrative: The overall objective of the project is to further improve the forensic capacities of the Serbian Ministry of the Interior relevant to provide physical evidence for processing of firearms and explosives trafficking and other firearms/explosives-related criminal cases and for international exchange relevant to the overall SALW-control investigative cycle. The improvements will include both forensic and administrative organizational units at all levels of the General Police Directorate, central, regional and local.The specific objective of the project is to contribute to the expanded scope of accreditation of the ballistic and the chemical laboratory of the NFC according to the ISO 17025 standard, and to further strengthen the NFC capacities, together with CSI units, Arson and Explosion Investigation Unit, as well as the Administrative Affairs Directorate to tackle FAE-related crime and misuse.

condition.narrative: Social and environmental sustainability will be enhanced through application of the UNDP Social and Environmental Standards (http://www.undp.org/ses) and related Accountability Mechanism (http://www.undp.org/secu-srm).

The Implementing Partner shall ensure that all of its obligations set forth under the section entitled “Legal Context and/or Risk Management Standard Clauses” are passed on to each responsible party, subcontractor and sub-recipient and that all the clauses under this section entitled “Risk Management” are included, mutatis mutandis, in all sub-contracts or sub-agreements entered into further to the Project Document
